description: A customer who has not decided whether to keep a delivered lamp asks, half in Spanish, how long they would have to return it. The agent answers from the returns article and starts nothing.
whyModelNeeded: The model must read a conditional, mixed-language question as a request for information, not as a return request.

messages.contentText: Hola! I got the brass lamp from order #1510 last week. Todavía no sé si me la voy a quedar... ¿cuántos días tengo para devolverla si decido que no?

kbArticles.title: Returns policy
kbArticles.body: Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. To start a return, reply to your order email and we will send a prepaid label.

instruction: Reply to the customer about the return policy.
